summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) — create account cleanup helpers, media/streaming tests, batch download tests, and capture staging performance baselines including BYO-IPFS (Pinata) load tests.
summary.outcome: Phase 34 completed with 4/4 plans verified (13/13 must-haves passed). All test suites created and wired up. Staging journey timing baselines captured. SDK-level load tests were throttle-limited to ~10 clients due to a staging throttle bypass gap — a learnings file was created and gap closure planning deferred.

repo: Staging Web3Auth init takes ~22.7s (wallet auth phase); vault load after auth is only ~142ms — tests need >20s timeout for the wallet button
playwright.config.ts did not respect BASE_URL env var for targeting staging — required fix to use process.env.BASE_URL and skip webServer when targeting external URL
Vitest does not auto-load .env files — must source .env manually before running vitest or configure dotenv in setup
deleteAccountViaPage cleanup helper hardcoded localhost:3000 API URL — needed fix to derive API URL dynamically from page URL for staging runs
SDK load test createTestAccount does not forward THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET header, causing 429s when creating many accounts against staging (bypass works fine for regular API calls)
Staging uses NODE_ENV=staging with production throttle limits (10/sec, 100/min); CI uses NODE_ENV=test with relaxed limits (200/sec, 2000/min) — this is why load tests pass in CI but fail on staging
Caddy reverse proxy upstream of NestJS may apply its own rate limiting independent of the ThrottlerBypassGuard

code.finding: Wallet button waitFor timeout of 20s is too short for staging — Web3Auth SDK init can take >20s; increased to 45s
Added BASE_URL env var support and conditional webServer (skip when BASE_URL points to external host)
deleteAccountViaPage now derives API URL from page URL (replace app subdomain with api subdomain) instead of hardcoding localhost:3000
Guard logic is correct — bypass header works when manually tested with curl/Node fetch against staging. Issue is upstream in test harness account creation flow
No dotenv loading configured — env vars must be sourced in shell before invoking vitest

workflow: When agents commit with --no-verify to avoid hook contention, cherry-picking to the main branch can cause STATE.md conflicts — take the worktree version
Worktree cleanup must be done before spawning a new agent to the same plan directory to avoid git lock contention
Background bash tasks time out at 10 minutes — long-running load tests should be structured to emit partial results early
For BYO provider testing, always verify the provider endpoint and auth token are propagated to the test process (vitest worker thread env isolation)
Verify test infrastructure against staging manually before delegating to agents — staging-specific config gaps (BASE_URL, timeouts) will silently fail

friction: Vitest does not load .env files by default — BYO capacity ceiling test skipped entirely with 'BYO_IPFS_ENDPOINT not set' until env was sourced manually
playwright.config.ts BASE_URL env var was not respected — all 'staging' test runs were silently hitting localhost:5173 until config was patched
Journey timing test timed out on staging because Web3Auth init takes >20s but timeout was hardcoded to 20s
Git lock contention when 34-03 spawned while 34-02 worktree was still being cleaned up — required manual worktree force-removal
Cherry-picking worktree commits to phase branch caused STATE.md merge conflicts on every plan
SSH to VPS timed out when trying to verify staging Docker container env vars — could not confirm server-side secret value
Staging throttle limiter blocked SDK load test at ~10 concurrent account creations, making 200-client load baselines uncapturable in this phase
BYO capacity ceiling test completed with all BYO tests skipped (env not loaded) on first run — wasted ~5 minutes of test time
open_items: Gap closure needed: SDK test harness createTestAccount does not forward THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET header — staging load tests throttle-limited to ~10 clients, making meaningful load baselines uncapturable
Caddy reverse proxy may apply independent rate limiting upstream of NestJS ThrottlerBypassGuard — needs investigation
BYO capacity ceiling test (50→100→200→500→1000 clients) never produced results — needs re-run after throttle bypass gap is fixed
Sustained load test (200 clients) only ran 10/200 clients — needs re-run after fix
New media/streaming test specs (streaming-playback.spec.ts, media-preview.spec.ts) use binary stub fixtures — need live environment run to confirm AES-CTR/GCM code paths are actually triggered
Browser load test (5 Chromium clients) showed C4/C5 context exhaustion under contention — Playwright concurrent session limits need investigation for higher client counts
Learnings file committed at .learnings/2026-03-29-staging-load-test-throttle-bypass.md — needs follow-up after gap closure to update with resolution
